{{Top|italics=1}}
{{Quote|Shiim is any kind of wound that is made with the edge of a lightsaber blade.|[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Shiim_SOC.png|thumb|250px|A Twi'lek uses shiim against an opponent.]]
In [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], '''''shiim''''' was a more minute [[Wikipedia:wound|wound]] to an opponent by the edge of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber's]] blade. It was considered inferior and a sign of desperation or struggle against a potent enemy. However, in use by a lightsaber master, this was regarded as either a taunt by a superior enemy or an immobilizing technique to stop a foe.

==Notable uses==
While [[Duel on Tython|dueling]] with [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Johun Othone]] scored a successful ''shiim'' strike against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] by slashing through a gap in his [[orbalisk]] armor at his exposed wrist, cutting him deeply, though it only enraged Bane into attacking more fiercely.<ref name="ROT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

[[File:Shiim.jpg|thumb|left|Obi-Wan Kenobi being brought low by Dooku's application of the ''shiim''.]]
[[Xanatos]] had received ''shiim'' twice on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]: the first came from his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on the shoulder; the next was soon inflicted by Jinn's new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on the sword hand.<ref name="Dark Rival">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref>

[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] performed two successful ''shiim'' strikes against Obi-Wan Kenobi while dueling on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], gracefully slashing both his left arm and leg.<ref name="SWAOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Dooku also used ''shiim'' against [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], gouging out the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]], and again against [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] during their [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|rematch on Vjun]], though it failed to bring him down.<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Republic: Trackdown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>

[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] applied ''shiim'' against [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in the arm on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] and would have finished him off, had he not dodged the killing blow in time.<ref name="Cestus">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] survived a ''shiim'' wound inflicted by Ventress on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], though it left him with a distinct facial scar over his right eye.<ref name="Star Wars Republic: The Dreadnaughts of Rendili">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref> Ventress later used this technique on a [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]]. She impaled his right eye, and if [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and Kit Fisto had not been present, he surely would have died from severe blood loss.<ref name="TCW 9">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>

[[Galen Marek]] was heavily scarred from the numerous ''shiim'' applications he inadvertently received from Darth Vader's missed attacks during their sparring matches.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> Vader later applied ''shiim'' on [[Tao (Sith Apprentice)|Tao]] under [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]' orders. He did the same to [[Siadem Forte]]'s left shoulder and right thigh, then [[Iwo Kulka]]'s abdomen and face, during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

Darth Vader himself suffered a ''shiim'' wound from each of his children: the first on his helmet from [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who [[Duel on Mimban|briefly fought]] him on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], causing him to return the favor in a few places;<ref name="Splinter">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref> the next on his right shoulder during his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|fight]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="SWTESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

A [[Unidentified female Saarai-kaar|Saarai-kaar]] had managed to apply ''shiim'' on [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]'s right thigh, though it was not serious enough to hamper him in [[Battle of Susevfi|their duel]].<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

During the [[Battle of Almania]], [[Kueller]] received a ''shiim'' in the side from Luke Skywalker, who was badly hurt in both of their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duels]].<ref name="New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

On [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Lowbacca]] scored a ''shiim'' on the shoulder of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Corrsk (Diversity Alliance)|Corrsk]].<ref name="Jedi Bounty">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref>

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] applied ''shiim'' against [[Nelani Dinn]] when he cut her thigh, rendering her unable to stand.<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Kruhl]] used ''shiim'' against [[Rikkar-Du]], brutally slashing him across the chest before killing him.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 13: Ready to Die">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>
